selected_hypothesis: LLY versus NVO same-date PEAD capacity-conversion ranking
economic_mechanism: Issuer-specific earnings updates from the two dominant global incretin suppliers can map to the same downstream PEAD decision date without being one common external shock. Volume-led growth supported by producible capacity may cause a more durable competitive-share expectation revision than price, mix or channel timing. The decision surface is a bounded same-decision-date ranking, not an entry exclusion or long-short trade.
falsifier: Reject or park unless issuer field definitions and publication clocks are comparable, canonical historical as-known pair rows provide at least five independent executable pair dates in every standard window, a dynamic-relation novelty axis survives, and H10/H20 replacement value beats the unconditioned PEAD ordering after costs and concentration controls.
